item.text: The starter has only database opening and placeholder handlers. I’m adding a shared SQLite schema and keeping the public job conversion centralized so HTTP responses stay consistent with the specified shape.

The API and worker are now wired to the same durable tables. The worker records progress after each delay, schedules retries in SQLite, and replays interrupted `running` rows with their existing attempt count. I’m adding the polling form and then compiling to catch TypeScript/runtime mismatches.
